art_direction: 成年家入硝子穿宽松白衬衫坐在深色茶室，托着茶杯，暖光与墨绿色背景沉静。
composition_variation: Create a sophisticated soft-oil anime portrait of adult Shoko Ieiri relaxing in a quiet tea room after work. Preserve her shoulder-length brown hair, tired gentle eyes, and distinctive small beauty mark beneath one eye. Dress her in a fully covering white linen shirt, dark trousers, and simple flats. She sits sideways on a wooden chair with a warm tea cup supported in both hands. Use deep forest green walls, amber table light, smoky mauve shadows, subtle ceramic textures, and quiet upper darkness. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
